summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 7 September 2026.
Total work logged: 8h 25m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (1h 45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Healthcheck for 5 stuck orders. 4 already completed since report. 1 remains stuck (SHIPPING_REQUESTED, partial cancellation failed). Needs consignment process retrigger. (25m)

AEME-6500 — 
  5 orders stuck post-split. 2 completed via stock update and prior remediation. 2 await warehouse confirmation. 1 has SMC UPDATE_ERROR — re-registration script ready in PC-53305, awaiting approval. (1h 0m)

AEME-6535 — 
  SUBS team requested 18 new SubscriptionData columns in daily SC+ report. Script written under PC-53535, reviewed. Awaiting QA approval to deploy via HAC scripting console. (25m)

AEME-6540 — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  NorthLadder auto-detected 2 rejected trade-ins and triggered clawback. Checkout.com declined both customer cards (2230 + 2195 AED). Orders completed, awaiting card update to re-trigger.

PC-5 — 
  Investigated via agent session.

PC-53305 — 
  Reusable PC ticket for SMC re-registration remediation. Script attached, awaiting approval to execute on order AE260819-63130115.

PC-53535 — 
  SC+ daily report enhanced with 18 new SubscriptionData columns (U-AL). Script created, reviewed by Vaibhav Jain. Parent ticket AEME-6535 in QA Server Review. (25m)

PC-53689 — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  SA Sales Report missing affiliate and multistore verification data. Groovy script updated with 2 new @ColumnMethod handlers, no build needed. Approved by D2C, production validation pending. (1h 0m)

SAME-3960 — 
  Screen repair order return blocked because GCIC service completed past cancellable window (ST030+). Order and payment healthy. Next: contact GCIC for manual rollback or enable isReturnEnabledForCleaningService config. (2h 30m)

TKME-2308 — 
  17 stuck TR orders across 5 categories. 5 already resolved, 12 remain (FI timeouts, GetMobil NPE, refund failures, warehouse blocks). No reusable PC ticket — new one needed. (20m)

TKME-2311 — 
  Master data creation for TR store C750_007_31536 (HARK MUHENDISLIK, Antalya). ImpEx script generated and field-verified against Excel source. Ready for PC ticket creation. (35m)

Open tickets:

PC-53689 [Approved-ES] — Add Affiliate_Name and Multistore_VerificationCode columns to SA Sales Report
  Todo: Approved by D2C
Please validate in production, then update the comments and also monitor the performance impact as well.

AEME-6282 [In Progress] — [For approval] Redeem rewards on impacted orders
  Todo: Hi ~@email ,

 

According to the API details, the requested amount exceeds the customer's current balance.

The custome

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAME-3958 [QA Server Review] — Sales Report - Additional Columns
  Todo: Awaiting QA review.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
